Hi @kofi, yes - for STOCKFLOW-110 ABC classification: the SKU that crosses a threshold belongs to the higher class. A SKU is 'A' if the cumulative share BEFORE adding it is still below a_pct, and 'B' if that share is below b_pct. Example: values 50/40/10 give A, A, B (the second SKU takes running share from 50% to 90%, but it started below 80%).

Hi @rhea, the design review notes in my handover are specifically for cycle_count_variance (your ticket STOCKFLOW-120). The key decision: A count covers the whole bin. If a location appears in `counts`, every system position in that location whose SKU was not counted is treated as counted 0 (variance = -system qty). Locations not counted at all are ignored, even if they hold stock. Hope this helps!
